1: Measured on the Bx28 and Bx38 between White Plains Rd and Boston Rd/Hering Av, about 0.7 miles of a road roughly 3 miles long. The rest of East Gun Hill Rd has no bus timepoint pair on the road.
2: Measured on the Bx9 between Jerome Av and E Fordham Rd, which follows East Kingsbridge Rd plus a short piece of E Fordham Rd. The stop data has only one timepoint on the road, so this is an approximation.
3: The plan covers Fordham Road from Sedgwick Av to Boston Rd. We measured Bx12 and Bx22 segments from Sedgwick Av to 3 Av/Webster Av, about 1 mile per direction. East of 3 Av there are no usable stop pairs. Segments that lack data in some baseline months are listed on the corridor page but not used.
4: Measured on the Bx39 between Westchester Av and E 233 St, about 4.3 miles per direction. Other parts of White Plains Rd have no usable stop pair.
5: Measured on the Bx40 and Bx42 from Castle Hill Av to Randall Av/Roosevelt Av, about 2.2 miles. The plan's Tremont Avenue Busway stretch (Webster Av to Southern Blvd) has no usable segment, so it is not covered.
6: Measured on the Bx1 and Bx2 from E 149 St to E Fordham Rd, about 3.5 miles per direction. The two routes share part of the road, so their segments overlap.
7: Measured on the Bx15 and Bx21 along 3rd Av from Westchester Av to E Fordham Rd/E 189 St, about 3.5 miles per direction. Some segments overlap. Two are left out because the source changed their recorded length during the comparison period.
8: Measured on the Bx19 along Southern Blvd from Hunts Point Av/E 163 St to the Botanical Garden stop, about 2.9 miles per direction, plus a short Bx5 piece inside that stretch. Southern Blvd south of E 163 St has no usable stop pair.
9: Not mapped. The plan names this corridor only as a future rapid bus study and gives no streets or routes, so there is nothing to measure yet.
10: Measured on the Bx6 and Bx13 along E 161 St and E 163 St from River Av to Southern Blvd, about 1.95 miles per direction. The plan says 1.75 miles and gives no endpoints, so this stretch is our best reading.
11: Not mapped. The plan names this corridor but gives no streets, routes or project description, so we did not guess.
12: Measured on the M125 along 125th St between Amsterdam Av and 3 Av. The plan gives no limits. No usable segment covers 125th St east of 3 Av.
13: Measured on the M101, M102 and M103 southbound on Lexington Av from E 124 St to E 96 St, which covers the plan's 95th to 125th St. The three routes run over the same blocks, so their segments overlap.
14: Measured on the M116 only, on 116th St. The plan also names Pleasant Av, Manhattan Av and Morningside Av but gives no limits, and few usable stop pairs lie on them. Treat this as part of the corridor.
15: Measured on the M79 SBS between Riverside Dr and East End Av, both directions. One westbound segment near Riverside Dr is left out because it is mostly a terminal loop off 79th St.
16: Not mapped. The plan names this corridor but gives no streets or routes, so we did not guess.
17: Measured on the M34 SBS and M34A SBS between 3 Av and 9 Av. No segment sits entirely inside the busway (about 1 mile), so we kept segments that are at least 30% inside. Speeds include some blocks outside the busway.
18: Measured on one M11 southbound segment from W 42 St to W 23 St, about half of which lies inside the plan's 32nd to 50th St limits. With one segment, treat it as rough.
19: Measured on the M101, M102 and M103 southbound, E 59 St to E 42 St. Under half of that segment lies inside the plan's 52nd to 60th St limits, so this is a weak stand-in.
20: Measured on the M5, M55 and M7 northbound along 6th Av from Grand St to W 57 St, which covers the plan's Lispenard St to 59th St. The routes overlap on some blocks. Two stop ids for the 6 AV/W 31 ST stop (one named W 31 ST/6 AV) are counted as the same stop.
21: Measured on the M1, M2, M3 and M4 northbound on Madison Av. The segments reach well north of the plan's 23rd to 42nd St limits, so speeds include Midtown blocks outside the project.
22: Not mapped. The plan limits are Broadway from 14th St to Houston St, but no bus segment has both stops on that stretch of Broadway.
23: Measured on the Q12, Q63 and Q66 where both stops are on Northern Blvd. The plan gives no limits. Two stretches are covered: Woodside Av to Junction Blvd, and the far east end. Nothing qualifies between Junction Blvd and 163 St.
24: Not mapped. The plan limits are Broadway from the BQE to Roosevelt Av (Q70 SBS), but no bus segment has both stops on that stretch.
25: Measured on the Q58 and Q59 along Grand St and Grand Av toward Queens Blvd. Eastbound starts at Metropolitan Av; westbound ends about 0.4 miles short of it. One Q59 segment is left out because the source changed its recorded length.
26: Measured on the Q23 along 108 St from Queens Blvd to Roosevelt Av, about 2.1 miles. The plan runs on to Astoria Blvd, about 0.8 miles more, which no segment covers. The source switched one southbound stop in July 2026, so that segment has no data since release; the corridor page says how many segments still report.
27: The plan gives no limits, so we used all of Main St in Queens that the data covers, Union Tpke to 38/39 Av, on the Q20, Q20A and Q20B. Nothing covers Linden Pl or Main St south of Union Tpke.
28: Measured on the Q20B, Q25 and Q34 where both stops are on Kissena Blvd, Union St or Parsons Blvd. Many hops across turns are not captured, so coverage is partial.
29: Not mapped. This is a planned new busway with no existing bus service on the route, so there is nothing to measure yet.
30: Measured on Q11 and Q21 segments on Woodhaven Blvd from Jamaica Av to Metropolitan Av, a stand-in for the plan's short project around Metropolitan Av. These segments are much longer than the project. Woodhaven (Union Turnpike/107 Ave) uses some of the same segments.
31: Measured on Q11 and Q21 along Woodhaven Blvd and Cross Bay Blvd from Metropolitan Av to 107 Av, about 2.4 miles per direction against the plan's 2 miles. Woodhaven/Metropolitan uses some of the same segments.
32: Measured on the Q54 and Q56 along Jamaica Av from Sutphin Blvd to about 170 St, close to the plan's Sutphin Blvd to 169th St, within about 0.1 miles.
33: Measured on the Q5, Q84 and Q85 on Merrick Blvd from Liberty Av to Linden Blvd. Some stop ids changed in mid 2025 and some segments lack data in some months, so fewer segments carry the figures than are listed.
34: Measured on the Q111, Q113, Q114, Q115, Q40 and Q6 on Guy R Brewer Blvd (Archer Av to Linden Blvd) and Sutphin Blvd. The plan's stretch, Liberty Av to Archer Av, is only about 0.2 miles, so these segments are much longer than the project. The plan gives no limits for Sutphin Blvd, so we used its full length in the data.
35: Measured on the B49 on Bedford Av, Bergen St to Avenue D. Coverage is mostly one direction, because northbound timepoints sit on Rogers Av.
36: Not mapped. The plan limits are Borinquen Pl to Broadway, but no bus stop in the data is on Marcy Av itself, so no segment can be matched.
37: Measured on the B45 on Livingston St between Court St and Smith St. The plan covers Gallatin Pl to Court St, so most of the stated stretch is not covered. Only the eastbound segment is used, because the source changed the recorded length of the westbound segment during 2026, which would look like a speed change. One segment is a small sample.
38: Measured on the B38 along DeKalb Av and Lafayette Av from Flatbush Av east to about Broadway, close to the plan's Broadway to Flatbush Av limits.
39: Measured on the B41 and B9 on Flatbush Av over the full length the data covers, Kings Plaza to Atlantic Av. The plan's 2026 project is only Livingston St to Grand Army Plaza, so speeds include a longer stretch than the project.
40: Measured along Utica Av from Avenue N to Fulton St. The plan gives no limits. Most trips are B46 local; the B46 SBS segments mostly end off Utica Av and are largely left out.
41: Measured on the B35 local along Church Av from McDonald Av to Kings Hwy, about 3.1 miles each way. The plan gives no limits. Church Av outside that stretch has no usable segment. Kensington-JFK uses these segments too.
42: The plan names four streets and gives no limits. We measured B15 and B35 segments on New Lots Av and Church Av. No segment has both stops on Linden Blvd or Conduit Av, so those streets are not covered. Church Ave uses some of the same segments.
43: Not mapped. The plan limits are Linden Blvd from Fountain Av to Conduit Av, but no bus segment has both stops on that stretch.
44: The plan defines this corridor as 7.5 miles of streets along the B82 SBS route without saying which streets. We measured the whole B82 SBS route and the B82 local between the same ends, so the figures cover the route, not only the project.
45: Not mapped. The plan gives no limits and only one bus timepoint is on Avenue J, so no segment can be matched.
46: Measured on the B6 on Bay Pkwy from 60 St to 86 St. The plan also names Cropsey Av, which has no usable stop pair, so it is not covered.
47: Measured on the B1 and B16 on 86 St in Brooklyn: B1 from Stillwell Av to 18 Av and B16 southbound from 5 Av to Narrows Av. About 1.6 miles between 18 Av and 5 Av is not covered.
48: Measured on the S51 and S81 on Bay St in Staten Island: S51 from Victory Blvd to Hylan Blvd, and S81 southbound to St Johns Av. Bay St north of Victory Blvd is not covered.
49: Measured on Victory Blvd from Bay St to Clove Rd on the S61, S62, S66, S91 and S92. The plan runs to Little Clove Rd, a few stops further west, which is not covered.
50: Measured on the S44, S79 SBS, S89 and S94 along Richmond Av from Hylan Blvd to Vedder Av. The plan gives no limits.
